_comment: Static source registry for the Phase 0.5 spike. License text is quoted verbatim from the URL in licenseVerifiedAt, checked on the date given. 01-download.mjs adds download date, byte size and sha256 to raw/_manifest.json; 07-report.mjs merges both into DATA_SOURCES.md.

sources.name: Wiktionary Spanish entries (English Wiktionary) via kaikki.org / wiktextract
sources.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 and GFDL (dual-licensed, inherited from English Wiktionary)
sources.licenseQuote: Text is available under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike License; additional terms may apply.
sources.attribution: Attribute English Wiktionary contributors; share-alike applies to derived text. Extraction tooling: wiktextract (Tatu Ylonen), served by kaikki.org.
sources.notes: kaikki's Spanish index page marks this postprocessed JSONL 'DEPRECATED' but still serves it; it is the only kaikki file with Spanish headwords and ENGLISH glosses as required by brief section 4. The downloads/es/ path is the SPANISH Wiktionary (Spanish glosses) and is NOT interchangeable.

sources.name: FrequencyWords Spanish frequency list (OpenSubtitles-derived)
sources.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (generated frequency lists; repository code is MIT)
sources.notes: TOKEN frequencies (surface forms), not lemma ranks. Brief section 12 requires form-to-lemma aggregation before these become lemma ranks.

sources.name: Fred Jehle's Spanish Verb Database (600+ fully conjugated verbs)
sources.attribution: Fred Jehle, Indiana University-Purdue University Fort Wayne; compiled by ghidinelli.
sources.notes: NONCOMMERCIAL. Compatible with a free personal app, but this dataset must stay separated from the app-code license and must never be relicensed with it.

sources.name: Tatoeba Spanish sentences (detailed export)
sources.license: CC BY 2.0 FR (default); some sentences also available under CC0 1.0
sources.licenseQuote: These files are released under CC BY 2.0 FR.
sources.attribution: Per-sentence: Tatoeba sentence ID, contributor username, license, and source URL https://tatoeba.org/en/sentences/show/<id>
sources.notes: Columns: id, lang, text, username, date_added, date_modified. Username may be blank for sentences with no current owner.

sources.name: Tatoeba English sentences (detailed export)
sources.license: CC BY 2.0 FR (default); some sentences also available under CC0 1.0
sources.licenseQuote: These files are released under CC BY 2.0 FR.
sources.notes: Needed to resolve the English side of each es-en link.
